newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI FINANCE FIRMS TOLD TO PRODUCE REVIVAL PLANS.
newsitem.headline: THAI FINANCE FIRMS TOLD TO PRODUCE REVIVAL PLANS.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand has told 42 newly suspended finance companies to produce, within two months, their revival plans including repayment of liquidity easing loans borrowed from a fund run by the central bank.
Central bank officials said executives of the 42 suspended firms were asked by the authorities on Wednesday to submit plans for solving their severe liquidity problems and improving their management.
Central bank governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi said on Tuesday the 42 firms had borrowed a combined 230 billion baht ($7.4 billion) from the bank to help ease a liquidity crunch.
He said another 16 finance firms suspended since late June had tapped another 200 billion baht from the central bank.
